headline: Weekend profit halved: Saturday did the damage, Sunday landed above par
commentary:
### The weekend
- **Weekend NP $3,226 at 5.2%** — half last weekend, a third of normal.
  - NP: $3,226 v $6,649 last weekend
  - Four-weekend average: $8,337
  - NM: 5.2% v 18.0% average
- We bought a lot more clicks and the value per lead didn't follow.
  - Search clicks: 4,749 v 2,961 average
  - Search EPL: $25.44 v $29.60 average
  - Weekend cost: $58,452 v $37,919 average
- Sunday on its own was a good one; Saturday carried the loss.
  - Sunday NP: $2,518 v $2,221 eight-Sunday mean
  - Sunday EPL: $17.78 v $17.63 eight-Sunday max
  - Saturday NP: $708
### Friday
- Friday banked $7,851 but margin gave up seven points on much heavier spend.
  - NP: $7,851 v $9,131 prior Friday
  - Cost: $48,708 v $34,721
  - NM: 13.9% v 20.8%
- Clicks up a third on Friday, and we paid up for them.
  - Search clicks: 3,425 v 2,564
  - Search CPC: $12.66 v $10.96
  - Search EPL: $28.38 v $31.06
### What drove it
- Sunday Search: a few more clicks, dearer, and each one worth less.
  - Search clicks: 1,823 v 1,768 last Sunday
  - Search CPC: $11.29 v $11.08
  - Search EPL: $24.23 v $26.80
- amount, bad_credit and cash_advance took the extra Sunday spend.
  - amount: $5,118 v $4,127 last Sunday
  - bad_credit: $1,701 v $942
  - cash_advance: $1,377 v $753
- **amount lost ten points of impression share while spending more.**
  - amount IS: 23.1% v 33.1% last Sunday
  - netcredit account IS: +3.2 points
  - albert account IS: +3.1 points
- Trees were not the problem — both big ones beat their week.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $25.19 v $20.50 last 7
  - Test tree EPL: $21.65 v $20.91
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 25/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| personal | tROAS, no SA | $83 | $210 | — |
| competitor | tROAS, no SA | $479 | $712 | — |
| speed | High tROAS, stepping down | $539 | $211 | — |
| Scavengers | tROAS plus tCPA copy | $1,074 | $1,210 | — |
- speed stays small by design while the target comes down.
  - speed CPC: $17.97 v $15.04 last Sunday
  - speed clicks: 30 v 14
- Scavengers ran through the weekend despite being scheduled off, clicks still cheap.
  - Scavenger clicks: 293 v 337 last Sunday
  - competitor_scavenger CPC: $3.39 v $3.13
watch: October is still the better month — NP $135,360 at 14.3% against 10.1% last month — but two weekends like this one take the shine off.
Search EPL ran $24.23 on Sunday against $28.68 month-to-date; a run of days under $26 would be a real move rather than weekend lumpiness.
amount's impression share at 23.1% on rising spend, with netcredit and albert both up three points at account level.
